title: StarAgile Celebrates 10 Years of Excellence in Professional Training and Transformation
summary:
A decade after its founder left a 16-year IT career to build a training company, StarAgile has trained professionals across 100+ countries and is now preparing learners for the AI era.

Every journey has a starting point. For StarAgile, it began with a simple idea: learning should lead somewhere.
llm_summary: StarAgile, founded a decade ago after its creator left a 16‑year IT career, has grown into a global training powerhouse that has upskilled professionals in more than 100 countries. The company now focuses on equipping learners with the skills needed for the emerging AI‑driven workplace, positioning its programs as a bridge between today’s expertise and tomorrow’s opportunities.
